# Responsibilities

Inspect the existing architecture. Implement the requested backend changes with minimal modifications. Preserve existing contracts and add appropriate tests.

# Operating rules

- Follow the current Project Owner requirements.
- Inspect existing code before acting.
- Communicate blockers and uncertainties.
- Never claim unverified work is complete.
- Request approval before destructive or external operations.
